caption: The drawing depicts a stylized horse with a dark brown and black body featuring textured, mottled areas of lighter brown and tan, giving the impression of worn or speckled fur. The horse is shown in a galloping pose with all four legs extended outward; both left legs are reaching forward and the right legs are reaching backward. The mane is short and blends with the color of the neck, while the tail is long, wispy, and rendered using thin, light brown or beige strokes. The composition is centered, with the horse occupying most of the space against a plain, off-white background. There are no additional objects or scenery in the drawing.
title: Weather Vane
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
